summary: In the previous topics, we gained a good understanding of heredity and inheritance, and how these various genetic patterns and laws contributed to the outward appearance of organisms. In Topic 5.5, we will explore how not only genetics, but also the environment, can affect phenotype.

vocab.definition: A type of genetic inheritance where a single trait is influenced by multiple genes, rather than just one gene
The ability of a single genotype to produce different phenotypes (observable characteristics) in response to different environmental conditions, such as temperature, diet, or predators
